selection_rule: Use the same ten official AL-SP instruments and order as v1. Replace only the five v1 annotations proven absent from the official HTML. Before measuring PDF ingestion, fail the run unless every HTML anchor is present in the captured official source text.
changes_from_v1: Four title anchors drop the source-inaccurate 'Decreto nº' prefix while retaining instrument number and date. The source-inaccurate energy phrase for Decreto 53.205/2008 is replaced by its Artigo 1º anchor. No document, threshold or pipeline outcome was selected based on v1 PDF matches.
metric_limitations: This is not character error rate, OCR accuracy, legal completeness, amendment completeness or legal validity. It only checks whether 30 source-validated title/article/topic anchors survive the PDF ingestion path.
